bundle.shortDescription: Offline universal converter, video compressor and YouTube downloader
bundle.longDescription: UtilBox is an offline-first toolbox: universal file conversion powered by FFmpeg, ImageMagick, LibreOffice, Pandoc and 7-Zip; MP4 compression; and YouTube downloads through yt-dlp. Only downloading media requires a network connection.
